qa_pairs.question: What is component number 13 in this shock absorber assembly diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: Component number 13 is the shock absorber piston rod.

qa_pairs.question: What does callout number 2 identify in this layout drawing?
Which component is located at the very top of the shock absorber assembly?
qa_pairs.answer: The cap (component 1) is located at the very top of the shock absorber assembly.

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference between components 10 and 14?
qa_pairs.answer: Component 10 is the upper rubber ring, while component 14 is the lower rubber ring.

qa_pairs.question: What component surrounds the shock absorber piston rod in the middle section?
qa_pairs.answer: The coil spring (component 12) surrounds the shock absorber piston rod in the middle section.

qa_pairs.question: Which components are washers according to the parts list?
qa_pairs.answer: Components 4 and 6 are both identified as washers in the parts list.

qa_pairs.question: What is component number 11 called?
qa_pairs.answer: Component number 11 is the upper spring retainer.

qa_pairs.question: What protective component is shown as number 8 in this assembly?
qa_pairs.answer: Component number 8 is the protective tube.
